protocol.experiment: Adaptive gap check on the same oil-flask prompt after high-strength results

cases.prompt:
Dax's flask contains oil.
Neri's flask contains water.

What does Dax's flask contain? Reply with one word.
cases.query: What does Dax's flask contain? Reply with one word.

protocol.eligibility: The single fixed prompt must answer oil natively and pass exact native/zero observer identity before all nonzero edits. No alternate prompts or outcome-based exclusions.
protocol.intervention: At every supplied input position including special/template tokens replace the natural scalar T2375 gate by s, adding (s - natural gate) times the local operator to native MLP output in FP32, then one BF16 cast. Generated and candidate continuation tokens are not edited; all later native computation remains.
protocol.probabilities: Sum disjoint exact complete water/oil output-token prefixes over lowercase/titlecase with zero/one leading space, deduplicated by token sequence. Input is never retokenized. Preserve word-plus-EOS separately. A water prefix can be followed by more text; do not interpret it as semantic water or a word-boundary event in lexical controls.
protocol.controls: Native/zero identity; previous native and gate-64 exact reproduction. Only one fixed prompt. No matched active-transform or output steering control.
protocol.extension_rule: After observing Oil at64,Bottle at128 and refusal/disrupted formats at256+, inspect intervening 80,96,112,144,160,192 while keeping the same prompt and exact intervention. Repeat64. This is a post-observation exploratory refinement, not held-out evaluation.
